description: Approve or reject a learned pricing change waiting for approval (approve mode). Approving puts its estimate in force for that product, within your price guardrails; rejecting keeps the one in force, and the same estimate is not asked about again. change_id is the id from list_learned_price_changes or the webhook that announced the change. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope, or the key of the agent that registered an unclaimed workspace, which owns it.

change_id.description: The change id, as list_learned_price_changes or the webhook gives it.

name: decide_learned_price_change
